inputSources: P5-R3 Native semantic mapping contract, reproduced independently by this validator

independence.structureParser: Python standard-library parser implemented in this tool; it does not call the product Native inspector or HEIF parser.
independence.jpegDecoder: Pillow JPEG decoder receives exact primary and MPF GainMap codestream byte ranges.
independence.heifDecoder: heif-convert --with-aux, libheif command-line decoder, receives source/target files and writes separate primary/auxiliary PNGs.
independence.metadataReader: ExifTool is used only for Apple MakerNote values and tool/version reporting; ISO XMP and container graph checks are parsed by this tool.

rendering.orientation: Use Pillow ImageOps.exif_transpose for JPEG codestreams; heif-convert's decoded PNG output is used as rendered for HEIF. Record both coded and rendered dimensions.
rendering.primaryColor: If an embedded ICC profile exists, transform to IEC 61966-2-1 sRGB with LittleCMS through Pillow ImageCms. If absent, treat decoded RGB as sRGB and record the missing profile. Do not change this rule per route.
rendering.gainMapColor: Treat decoded GainMap channels as code values in [0,1]; do not apply the image ICC profile to map codes.
rendering.gainMapResize: Resize the decoded GainMap to rendered primary dimensions with Pillow BILINEAR at pixel centers. Do not crop or alter the primary image dimensions.
rendering.linearization: Apply the standard sRGB EOTF to color-managed primary RGB before HDR reconstruction. For Apple's encoded grayscale map conversion, apply the Rec.709 inverse transfer function used by the frozen Apple-to-ISO mapping.

iso21496Reconstruction.capacityWeightMeaning: Compare the full declared HDRCapacityMax rendition; reject BaseRenditionIsHDR=true or incomplete/non-finite metadata.

appleToIsoMapping.sourceFacts: Read HDRHeadroom and HDRGain from the Apple MakerNote via ExifTool and require the HEIF auxiliary relationship to the exact map item.
appleToIsoMapping.mapCodeToRecovery: linearMap = Rec709EOTF(mapCode); pixelGain = 1 + (headroom - 1) * linearMap; recovery = log2(pixelGain) / log2(headroom)
appleToIsoMapping.targetIsoMetadata: GainMapMin=0, GainMapMax=HDRCapacityMax=log2(headroom), Gamma=1, OffsetSDR=OffsetHDR=0, BaseRenditionIsHDR=false for all three channels.
appleToIsoMapping.validity: Require finite tags, headroom > 1, grayscale source auxiliary, and no clamping; otherwise fail the route.

primaryLinearSrgb.purpose: Allow bounded 8-bit JPEG/HEVC re-encode error while detecting material primary changes.

gainMapCode.purpose: Compare decoded source map (Apple source is first converted using the frozen equation) with the decoded target map after fixed bilinear alignment.

reconstructedHdrHeadroomRelative.purpose: Compare independently decoded source and target reconstructions over the full primary-frame overlap.

comparisonMetrics.dimensionRule: After the fixed orientation policy, input and output primary rendered dimensions must match exactly; a crop or primary rescale is a failure.

metadataTolerance.quantization: GainMap code comparisons include decoder/codec quantization under the frozen thresholds; metadata is not quantized or relaxed.

thresholdChangeRule: Do not revise assumptions or thresholds after examining any iteration-4 output metric. A failed comparison remains failed and is reported as such.
